shellCommands.command: git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5 && ls -la && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100
cat package.json index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts; ls node_modules | head -50; ls node_modules/.bin 2>/dev/null | head -30

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/ 2>/dev/null && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts && sed -n 1,80p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; grep -n '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -i tsc; node -v

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; grep -n "theme\|view\|qa" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/MenuItem/MenuItem.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/ | head -30

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Menu/MenuItem.d.ts | head -60; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -40; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head; grep -n '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json
./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit; echo "tsc exit $?"; ./node_modules/.bin/vite build 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "vite exit $?"

rm -rf dist && (which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer|jsdom|happy-dom" ; true) && git status --short
